title: Module 30 — Discrete Math & Linear Algebra
description: Linear algebra and discrete math on a plain CPU with numpy: dot products as similarity, a matrix as a transformation, eigenvalues confirming A·v = λ·v, a graph's adjacency matrix and reachability by matrix powers, and modular arithmetic with the pigeonhole principle.
